data.name: Data Center Simulator Game
data.detailed_description:
Update: Early Access Release (last week of June), new direction below:

Data Center Simulator Game: Every System Has a Secret

Step into the racks, the raised floors, and the endless hum of a modern data center. Play your way with full controller and keyboard support. Walk the cold aisles, route the cabling, balance the thermal load, and feel the weight of every decision. From your first server install to a fully orchestrated facility, every watt, every degree, and every cable matters. But the deeper you go, the more you'll sense that something here doesn't quite add up.

DCSG is a hands-on simulation that respects the craft of real infrastructure work, because the developer has done it for two decades across a variety of industries spanning the globe. Provision compute, manage power and cooling, respond to failures, and learn the trade through doing, including the hard lessons. It's built to teach by experience, not by menus. And it's built to keep you wondering what lies beneath the surface.

More than a sim: a world to explore.
DCSG grows beyond the server room. Expect RPG progression, a combat system, unique gear, and discoveries waiting in an unknown world. Some doors open only for those paying attention. Some systems were never meant to be found. The further you push, the more the familiar begins to fall away, revealing something far stranger than a server farm.

A long-term commitment, not a one-and-done release.
DCSG launches into Early Access with a clear roadmap ahead. Two premium DLC expansions are planned. The first is a historical timeline journey through the evolution of computing and data infrastructure. The second is a TOP SECRET project, developed as our thank-you to the community that made this possible, and what it contains will not be spoken of until the moment it arrives. Both will be followed by years of free, feature-rich content updates and expansions, with occasional paid DLC as needed to secure further development efforts on new features and experiences. When you buy in, you're investing in a title designed to grow for the long haul. A dedicated VR experience is also on the way as a separate title, arriving less than six months after launch.

Built on two decades of the real thing.
This isn't a sim made by people guessing at how infrastructure works. DCSG draws on 20 years across enterprise IT, defense, and large-scale systems, translating real operational experience into a game that gets the details right and brings authenticity rarely seen in the genre. Every detail is deliberate. Even the ones that seem out of place.

Whether you're a curious newcomer or someone who's spent a career in the field, the truth of this place won't reveal itself all at once. DCSG is yours to build, to break, to defend, and to conquer. Just remember: every system has a secret, and this one has been keeping its longest.


**Early Access, this title will continue to expand, images are of prototype systems slated for global availability 1 week after Early Access launch.  First main data center space will unlock MONDAY 29 June to both early access AND playtest users as a continued thank you to the community.

Playtest minus premium tools and equipment/maps will be available for free to play until July 8th as a thanks to the gaming community for your continued support and encouragement over the last six years of this journey.

-DCUplink
(formerly =[SA]=Silencer from CS1.0-CS1.6 days)

data.short_description: From unfinished ground to multi facility campuses you'll build it all while managing the needs of your demanding customers! Racks, Cluster planning, UPS beeping, Fires, Water intrusion, Insider Threats and more!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 11
  • Processor: i7
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX capable GPU
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • VR Support: not at this time, VR has been paused (was working)

  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 11
  • Processor: i9
  • Memory: 24 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 40 series or greater
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • VR Support: not at this time, VR has been paused (was working)
